photos.name: buns-fresh-from-oven
photos.summary: Eight sourdough cinnamon buns fresh out of the oven in a glass Pyrex dish lined with parchment paper, showing golden tops with defined cinnamon swirl spirals and caramelized filling visible at the edges.

photos.name: buns-glazed-closeup
photos.summary: Close-up of glazed cinnamon buns coated in a thick, glossy cream cheese glaze, with the soft swirled tops partially obscured under a generous layer of icing.
